title: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: An elf prince of Kaldheim who uses transmutation to cloak himself and Zimone in the House's flesh and watched Koma and the World Tree fall to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A Quandrix student who reads Marina's diary and deduces that Valgavoth has swallowed the outside.

entities.name: Marina Vendrell
entities.description: A teenage girl whose diary tells how she befriended the bound Valgavoth, was bullied, and let him take four classmates; the House protects her.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: A demon summoned and bound in the house by an earlier owner who became the House itself and grows by swallowing the world.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: The sparkless Emperor of Kamigawa, captured by the cult with Nashi and Niko.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A former planeswalker from Theros who leaps to defend a captive and is seized by the cultists.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A nezumi child who follows his mother's call into the Valley of Serenity.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A survivor guide who warns of the Cult of Valgavoth and then drops a granite slab to seal the others in with the cultists.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Nashi's mother, present only as a scroll echo held in a device by the cult, which records her stories.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who escapes to Ravnica, finds he cannot planeswalk back to the House, and hears from Niv-Mizzet's team.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon on Ravnica who learns from Kaito that Jace left him.

entities.name: Aminatou
entities.description: A fate-sensing girl who tells Kaito the trouble is in the House, not in him.

entities.name: Madame Etrata
entities.description: Niv-Mizzet's associate who meets Kaito.

entities.name: Proft
entities.description: A researcher who has an idea to help Kaito.

entities.name: Yoshimaru
entities.description: The Wanderer's dog, who stays with Aminatou.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who left Kaito in the pit.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: A being of Kaldheim whom Tyvar revered, who fell to Phyrexian transformation.

entities.name: Rootha
entities.description: Someone whose diary Zimone once read.

entities.name: Cult of Valgavoth
entities.description: Robed worshippers of the Devouring Father in the Valley of Serenity who hunt survivors to convert them or feed Valgavoth.

entities.name: The Valley of Serenity
entities.description: A huge pastoral cavern region of the House where the cult lives.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The hungry house-world that is Valgavoth and repels attack on Marina.

entities.name: An Architectural Accounting
entities.description: A history of the house begun by its last resident-architect that each owner must update.

entities.name: Marina's diary
entities.description: The diary Zimone takes that records Marina's friendship with Valgavoth and the disaster.

entities.name: Gift of the Threshold
entities.description: The cult's ritual promising to cleanse initiates of fear through a chrysalis.

entities.name: Glimmer
entities.description: The Wanderer's glimmer drifts around her shoulders.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Where Tyvar watched allies lose themselves.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: Tyvar's home plane where the World Tree burned.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane Kaito flees to.

events.summary: Tyvar tells Zimone how he saw allies, Koma and the World Tree lost to Phyrexian transformation, and how he senses it to time his camouflage.
events.quote: Koma, who I had revered, whose favor I had sought, fell to that cruel transformation.

events.summary: Tyvar and Zimone find an impossible sunlit room where a teenage girl writes in a diary.
events.quote: Sunlight streamed through the two closed windows, bathing the teenage girl who sat on one of the larger couches

events.summary: When the girl leaves, the room turns back into a rotting House room with blood in her footprints.
events.quote: Clouds immediately choked the sky outside, swallowing the sunlight

events.summary: Zimone realizes the girl repels the House and asks Tyvar to drop his camouflage.
events.quote: Whatever she is, she's repelling the House.

events.summary: Marina sees the strangers and screams; they introduce themselves.
events.quote: Marina Vendrell.

events.summary: Marina explains An Architectural Accounting, the book Zimone found, and admits to annotating it.
events.quote: That was started by the last person to live here.

events.summary: Marina denies the truth, chanting that they are not real, and the room erupts with nightmare beasts.
events.quote: You're not real, you're not here, you're not real, you're not here.

events.summary: The walls open and nightmare beasts crawl out as Tyvar drags Zimone away.
events.quote: the rest of the room began to warp and twist, the walls opening into holes from which crawled pustulant nightmare beasts

events.summary: Zimone reveals she grabbed Marina's diary.
events.quote: I got her diary

events.summary: The diary reveals that Marina met Valgavoth, a demon summoned and bound in the house by an earlier owner.
events.quote: His name is Valgavoth—Val—and he was summoned here and bound by one of the owners before us.

events.summary: Marina chooses not to free Valgavoth because he is her only friend.
events.quote: Val is the only real friend I've made since we moved here.

events.summary: After being bullied, Marina decides to invite her tormentors home and let Valgavoth make them pay.
events.quote: I'll invite them over tomorrow after school.

events.summary: Valgavoth takes the girls, pulling them into the walls.
events.quote: He took them. Hands reached out of the walls and grabbed them

events.summary: Marina realizes Valgavoth has become the house and is eating the world around him.
events.quote: I think Val is the house, somehow, after all this time

events.summary: Zimone concludes Valgavoth has swallowed the outside, leaving no plane beyond the House.
events.quote: I think at this point, mathematically speaking, Valgavoth is all.

events.summary: Winter warns that they have entered the Valley of Serenity, home of the Cult of Valgavoth; Nashi insists on continuing.
events.quote: The Cult of Valgavoth lives here.

events.summary: Winter explains the cult's belief and that it captures survivors to convert or feed to Valgavoth.
events.quote: They claim Duskmourn was created by an entity summoned by their ancestors

events.summary: The party enters a cavern of robed cultists who hold three bound survivors and hang chrysalises.
events.quote: Half a dozen humanoid figures in long robes shaped like moth's wings

events.summary: A frightened captive accepts the cult's offer and is led toward a chrysalis.
events.quote: As a group, they pulled her toward the nearest chrysalis, which was split down the middle, and began to ease her inside.

events.summary: Niko leaps onto a stalagmite and challenges the cultists.
events.quote: They jumped onto the nearest stalagmite, a shard appearing in either hand.

events.summary: Cultists seize the Wanderer, Nashi and Niko while Winter bows his head and does not resist.
events.quote: Winter only bowed his head, saying nothing, as the cultists rose up and grabbed Niko in turn.

events.summary: Winter drops a granite slab that seals the others in with the cultists.
events.quote: A slab of solid granite crashed down between him and the others, sealing them in the room with the cultists.

events.summary: The cult leader's book releases silver dust that knocks the captives unconscious.
events.quote: their leader raised his book and blew across the pages, and a thick layer of dust rolled off the paper

events.summary: The Wanderer wakes bound to a post in a larger cavern.
events.quote: she was able to shake off the lingering effects of the sedative dust to find herself held up by loops of some white, cottony material, pinning her tightly to a post.

events.summary: The Wanderer sees Tamiyo's scroll echo held in a device as a cultist records her stories.
events.quote: Tamiyo's scroll echo floated there, flickering in and out of focus, like it hurt her to be manifest.

events.summary: The cult leader says Valgavoth can now spread to more worlds merely by knowing they exist.
events.quote: He no longer needs to strain with all his might to open a door.

events.summary: The cult leader offers the Wanderer a chance to join them.
events.quote: we would be gloriously glad if you would join us

events.summary: Kaito appears in the Ravnica alley where he first met Zimone.
events.quote: The sounds of Ravnica were like an assault after the eerie quiet of Duskmourn.

events.summary: Kaito finds bloodstained wood in his hand and discovers he cannot planeswalk back to the House.
events.quote: A piece of bloodstained wood rested in his hand, a parting gift from Duskmourn.

events.summary: Kaito tells Niv-Mizzet that Jace left him.
events.quote: He said he was sorry, and he left me.

events.summary: Aminatou says the House now knows Kaito and does not want him inside.
events.quote: The trouble isn't in you. It's in the House.

events.summary: Proft offers Kaito an idea to help rescue his friends.
events.quote: If you would come with me, I think I have an idea that might help us

relations.note: Her only real friend, until she lets him loose.
relations.quote: Val is the only real friend I've made since we moved here.

relations.note: Marina believes Valgavoth has become the House.
relations.quote: I think Val is the house, somehow, after all this time

relations.note: Worships him as the Devouring Father.
relations.quote: The Devouring Father has not yet refused your service

relations.note: They hold her captive and call her a heretic.
relations.quote: If you wish to remain heretics, I cannot save you

relations.note: Drags her to safety from the beasts.
relations.quote: He ran, pulling her with him.

relations.note: The House protects Marina and attacks her visitors.
